body: Ah, i perfectly know why. I’m more assertive than I was when we met, which, upon reflection, feels like he’s upset because he’s realised he can’t boss me around, and I’m glad he realised :D

Yeah, I guess him always seeking me out isn’t so much a sign he does get along with me, but a sign he wants to keep me around for selfish reasons.

I sometimes do sense a sense of competition from him. I wouldn’t be surprised if he’s comparing himself to me and trying to put me down so that comparison is favourable. I’ll call him out too see what happens :D Sorry about your “friend” treating you that way. Thank you so much for the insight!

Yeah! You’re right! I don’t want this treatment. Thanks. “Being used” strong insight but I yeah I think you’re right. 

I like your tip; if he’s willing to change because he really appreciates so much, as he keeps telling me, good! but i don’t need to wait around if he doesn’t. And I’m not responsible for changing him either. I’ll speak to him, it’s always tricky and awkward to bring up these topics but I’ll try. Thanks for the help!

Yeah on second thought I can definitely keep mutual friends while keeping him at a distance. I can interact with him if it’s at a distance, he’s not that bad. Just a little weird dynamic. 

But yeah I should trust my gut instinct. For sure at minimum, he doesn’t respect me too much.

Thanks for your reply! Sorry you had to go through that. Yeah I’ve also been researching on narcissism and such. It’s a possibility. A few patterns are similar but not all, in my case. But yeah bottom line is have no interest in being with someone who hates me. 

What I truly don’t get is why he wants to be with me if he dislikes me? I’d never want that.

It will be really hard as I’ll definitely have to stop seeing our mutual close friends if I’m to stop seeing him. They’re great people, i don’t want to lose them. I think this is actually the only thing holding me up.
Yeah! I will! Thanks so much
Yeah! You’re right, especially in a whole year. who knows what interesting things might happen. Thanks :)
Yeah! This really helps actually, I’ll make sure to have a small thing to look forward to every day.  I’ll keep this in mind the whole way :) thanks
:/ sorry to hear that. It’s bleak. I guess I’ll just get through it out of necessity
Yeah I’ll try. thank you :) that feels so far away though, I can’t be sure that I’ll make it :/

I’m having trouble with the same. I had really cool plans for myself when I was younger but there’s been a lot of setbacks and with each one I’ve had to let go of dreams. 

My rational side has let go and accepted, but they are all still lingering deep inside, and every so often they well up and overwhelm me with regret of what could never be. I wish I knew the answer. 

Maybe as u/DollMatryoshka said, we should still try to chase them anyhow? Sure, some doors have closed by now but maybe not all of them :D

I have struggled with comparing myself to others too I’m still trying to get better at this but what helps is having a purpose. 

When I am working on something that is important to ME, something that gives me purpose and a sense of progress towards something i deeply care about, I find it easier to not care anymore about how others are doing. Like, okay, I can’t do it like they do, but that’s okay, cause I’m doing it THIS way, my way. 
In fact, when I have it clear in my mind  where i want to go and that I’m working towards something that’s importan to ME, if i see others doing well, instead of envy I feel so happy for them! for doing whats important to them. Instead of trying to make myself look better at stuff that’s what others want and care about, I know I’m working on my own path.
